description: This file defines command-line interface logic for managing Kubernetes namespaces, including viewing and setting the current namespace, with functions for command setup, argument parsing, validation, and configuration updates.

classes.name: NamespaceOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration and state for namespace management commands, including flags, current context info, and I/O streams.

methods.name: NewNamespaceOptions
methods.description: Creates a new NamespaceOptions instance with default values.

methods.name: NewCmdNamespace
methods.description: Constructs a new Cobra command for namespace operations.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Populates NamespaceOptions fields based on command-line arguments and flags.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks if the provided arguments and configuration are valid.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the command to list namespaces or update the current namespace.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Updates the configuration to set a new namespace and current context.
